top_choice_rationale: P002 (Buchwald and Hartwig, catalytic ligand-controlled Pd C-N cross-coupling) is the most mature and cleanly attributed achievement on the slate: a general method built on mechanistic understanding of oxidative addition, amine binding and C-N reductive elimination, confirmed independently for about thirty years and used daily in pharmaceutical and materials synthesis. The two-person allocation matches the two parallel general solutions, and the 'catalytic, ligand-controlled' wording separates it from the stoichiometric Kosugi precedent and from the 2010 C-C coupling prize. P001 (targeted protein degradation) is a strong second but its allocation is more contested; P003 (genetic code expansion) is third; no award is last since several mature achievements are available.
